patthana16.50:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ hetuñceva hetusampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na hetuceva na hetuvippayuttoca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana16.50:2.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ hetusampayuttañceva nacahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na hetuvippayuttoceva na nahetuca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. sanidassanattika nahetusahetukaduke nasanidassanattika nahetunasahetukadukaṃ
